<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/ai/models (route, a path literal in AiModelsResponseSchema))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/ai/models (route, a path literal in AiModelsResponseSchema))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **172** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7844272c47fd4e83cae6f4770b878d70b5a37e13` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8c0365f6d494d8bafe6666cb0f1b26175f49d4fe` — the merge of head `8e2c2d79aa60284f45e012e73553d1bb53f83072` into base `7844272c47fd4e83cae6f4770b878d70b5a37e13`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8c0365f6d494d8bafe6666cb0f1b26175f49d4fe && git checkout 8c0365f6d494d8bafe6666cb0f1b26175f49d4fe
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7844272c47fd4e83cae6f4770b878d70b5a37e13 8e2c2d79aa60284f45e012e73553d1bb53f83072 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7844272c47fd4e83cae6f4770b878d70b5a37e13 && git merge --no-ff 8e2c2d79aa60284f45e012e73553d1bb53f83072

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7844272c47fd4e83cae6f4770b878d70b5a37e13
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7844272c47fd4e83cae6f4770b878d70b5a37e13` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `387c17942f91721ca9470a679578cc3225b920d8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx

Read: card #33660 (body and its 4 comments: priority note 6889533808, triage first touch 6889924748, claim 6890495150, os-dev-report 6891945992), PR #33746 (body, 21 files, net diff against merge-base `5604aeb0`), and the check-runs on the head. The remaining 17 files (two pin files, `protocol.test.ts`, eleven i18n packs, two docs pages, the changeset) are the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT` and are not judged here.

Check-runs on the head at 2026-11-15T08:55Z: 50 runs: 14 success, 13 skipped, 23 in progress, 0 failed. Green so far: Check Changeset (one of its two runs), Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate. Still running: Build Core / Docs / UI Deps, every Lint family, Type Check (workspace, consumer gates, debt ledger), Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Live E2E UI, the second Check Changeset run. This record judges the contract; the gate verdicts are not in, and landing waits for them.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@objectstack/spec` `AiModelsResponseSchema`, object entry gains `costMultiplier?: number`: right.** It is `z.number().positive().optional()`: additive, and no payload that parsed on `main` is refused. The bare-string arm of the union is untouched. The spec is on zod `^4.6.6`, where `z.number()` refuses `NaN` and `Infinity`, so "positive" also means finite. The accept-set moves by exactly one optional member.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: right.** The schema describes a wire response (`GET /api/v1/ai/models`), not anything a metadata author writes. `Spec property liveness` is green on the head.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` `ChatbotModelOption.costMultiplier?: number`: right.** Additive optional member on an exported interface.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` `ChatbotEnhancedProps.allowanceUsedFraction?: number`: right.** Additive optional prop; absent keeps today's rendering.
- **`useAiModels` return shape: right.** Each model may now carry `costMultiplier`; no caller of the old shape breaks.
- **Six i18n keys under `chatbot.modelPicker`: right**, additive. `@object-ui/app-shell` exports nothing new (`ChatPane` props are unchanged).
- **Nothing is removed or narrowed.** No public-surface change is implied by the diff beyond the three the PR body lists.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right, and it stands line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, with `Metadata-protocol: none` beside it.
- AGENTS.md step 3: the level follows the metadata-protocol kind alone, and `none` takes `patch`. A non-protocol widening ships `patch`. So `patch` on `@objectstack/spec` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` is right.
- `@object-ui/i18n` (new keys) and `@object-ui/console` (`ui/apps/console`, which ships the private `@object-ui/app-shell`) are moved by the diff, and `patch` is right for both. Naming the private `@object-ui/app-shell` is harmless.
- `@object-ui/components` is only imported from (`AlertDialog`, already exported), so it rightly has no entry.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: empty.** Nothing to answer.
- **Out-of-scope finding, cloud producer: confirmed and escalated to the seat.** Nothing in this repository answers `/ai/models`; the spec's own comment above the AI block says the dispatcher only proxies `/api/v1/ai/**` and answers 501 with no service. So the member has no producer until cloud `service-ai` fills it. The seat owes the cloud card (the card's priority comment names cloud#4537), `Blocked-by` #33660. That card must carry two sentences from this contract:
  - the value is a ratio against the environment's default model, so the entry with `default: true` carries exactly 1. `cost_weight` is on a haiku scale (cloud#4438), so cloud divides by the default model's weight and does not pass the raw weight through;
  - the value is a finite positive number or the member is absent, never 0 or null.
- **Deviation, i18n keys in all 11 packs:** accepted; the parity test forces it. It is the lane seat's remainder.
- **Deviation, `ChatDockConversation.tsx` and `StudioAiCopilot.tsx` unchanged:** right. On the head both render `ChatPane` (`ChatDockConversation.tsx:151`, `StudioAiCopilot.tsx:124`), and `ChatPane` holds the only `useAiModels` call in the UI tree (`AiChatPage.tsx:2139`). No host reaches the picker by another path.
- **Deviation, one bullet on `plugin-chatbot.mdx` outside the order's file surface:** the lane seat's remainder; not a contract matter.
- **Deviation, local suites narrowed, full suites left to CI:** noted. The Test Core shards and Live E2E UI are still running on this head.
- **Deviation, no assignees on `pr_create`:** process, not contract.
- **"Asks once" read as once per pick at or above 20, not once per session:** agrees with the card ("a pick at ×20 or above asks once before applying"). Held.
- **Line budget, about 718 against about 600:** the seat already agreed to one PR. Not a contract matter.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: holds against the card's ruling and against the picker.**

- Optional, positive, and the bare-string entry is kept: yes to all three.
- The `.describe()` names its producer (cloud `service-ai`'s `GET /api/v1/ai/models`, from the model's cost weight) and what absence means. That satisfies ADR-0049 for a member this repo cannot fill, and matches how the surrounding block already declares "the wire, not a protocol this repo serves".
- The spec's conventions forbid nothing here: camelCase member, `.describe()` present, inside the existing `lazySchema`, generated docs regenerated.
- **should-fix: "the default model is 1" is stated as a convention, not a contract.** The describe says it in a parenthesis ("the environment's default model (which is 1)"), and "from the model's cost weight" can be read as the raw weight. The schema cannot enforce it across entries. The picker's sentences depend on it: the allowance note and the confirmation both say "N times as fast as the default model". With a raw haiku-scale weight and a non-haiku default, those sentences would be false. The definition as written is still correct, so this is not a must-fix; one clause ("normalised so the `default: true` entry carries 1") would make it a contract. Until then the cloud card in ③ carries it.

**`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts`: agrees.**

- `costMultiplierOf` keeps a finite positive number and drops everything else (`'20'`, 0, negatives, `NaN`, `Infinity`, null), and the key is omitted, not set to undefined. A model never gets a guessed multiplier.
- Read, not reviewed: `normalize` drops bare-string entries (it filters on `m.id`), as it does on `main`. That predates this card and is outside it.

**`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: agrees, with three findings below must-fix.**

- `×N` is drawn only when `costMultiplier !== undefined`; a model with none draws none; `×1` is drawn only for a served 1.
- The threshold compares `costMultiplier ?? 0` as at-or-above `EXPENSIVE_MODEL_MULTIPLIER` (20): exactly 20 asks, no off-by-one, and an absent value never asks.
- The `Select` is controlled, so the shown model does not move while the question is open. Cancel, Escape and an outside dismiss all go through `onOpenChange` and write nothing. Confirm writes once and closes.
- Keyboard: every pick path (Enter in the open list, typeahead on the closed trigger) goes through the same `onValueChange`, so none skips the question. Re-picking the current model fires nothing.
- The note uses only `allowanceUsedFraction`, clamped to 0..1, as a whole percent. No token count and no estimate of messages: rule D5 holds.
- **should-fix: display rounding disagrees with the threshold at its edge.** `multiplierText` rounds to two decimals. A value in 19.995 up to 20 is drawn `×20` and applies with no question; a value below 0.005 is drawn `×0`. Compare the rounded value, or draw without rounding up across the threshold.
- **should-fix: the pending pick is a snapshot.** `confirming` holds the option object. If the model list changes while the dialog is open (a refetch, an `apiBase` change), Confirm still writes that id, and the picker then shows it as the outside item. Re-resolve by id on confirm, or clear `confirming` when the model leaves the list. The list is fetched once per pane, so this is rare.
- **nit: the picker trusts `costMultiplier` from a direct host.** A host that feeds `models` itself, without `useAiModels`, and passes `NaN` or a negative gets `×NaN` drawn. The hook is the guard today; the typed prop makes this the host's error.
- **nit:** the `×N` span is inside `ItemText`, so it is part of the item's typeahead text and its announced name. Harmless.

**`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`: agrees.**

- `useAiUsage` is enabled only once some model carries a multiplier, so an environment whose service fills none makes no new request and looks as it does on `main`.
- `allowanceUsedFraction` is `pool.fraction` only, and is undefined when the pool is unmetered, the fraction is null, or usage is not served (404, bad shape). `useAiUsage` already refuses a non-finite fraction.
- The prop reaches the one `ChatbotEnhanced` that `ChatPane` renders, so all three hosts get the multiplier, the note and the question from one place.
- **nit:** where the dock's usage ring is also mounted, `/ai/usage` is read by two hook instances. No effect on correctness.

No must-fix. Two should-fix in the picker and one in the describe, none of which changes the published shape.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-cv4ljj`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `098d07e5477e2aadd128431142cbb3a475866a88`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx

This is a delta on the round-1 record (PASS on `387c17942f91721ca9470a679578cc3225b920d8`, comment 6891993315). Everything that record judged and this one does not name stands as written there.

Read: the round-1 record, the delta `387c1794..098d07e5` (two commits, four files: `protocol.zod.ts`, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, the regenerated `protocol.mdx`, the picker's pin file), card #33660 and its 4 comments, the current PR body, and the check-runs on the head. `useAiModels.ts` and `AiChatPage.tsx` are unchanged in the delta and were re-read at the head only where the changed picker meets them. The pin file and `protocol.mdx` are the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Nothing of the tree was built or run; the rounding cases in ④ were worked through from the two expressions as written, with the arithmetic checked in a standalone `node -e` that loads nothing from the repository.

Check-runs on the head at 2026-11-15T09:37Z: 68 runs, all completed: 59 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed, 0 in progress. Green: Build Core / Docs / UI Deps, every Lint family, every Type Check family, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate. The 9 skipped are opt-in or queue-only jobs. Round 1 left the gate verdicts open; they are in now, and green.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The published shape does not move in the delta.** `costMultiplier` is still `z.number().positive().optional()`; only its `.describe()` text changes. The accept-set is the one round 1 judged.
- **No exported symbol is added.** `drawnMultiplierOf` and `EXPENSIVE_MODEL_MULTIPLIER` are module-private; `ChatbotModelOption` and `ChatbotEnhancedProps` are untouched.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: still right.** `Spec property liveness` is green on the head.
- **One behaviour edge moves, and it is the one S2 asked for:** a multiplier of 19.995 up to 20 now asks before applying. It is drawn `×20`, so the changeset's "a pick at ×20 or above asks" is still a true sentence.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still stand line-initial in the PR body and in the changeset at the head. The delta does not touch the changeset.
- `patch` on all five packages still holds: the delta adds no surface, removes none, and a describe-text change takes no level of its own.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Cloud producer card: still owed by the seat**, `Blocked-by` #33660 (the card's priority comment names cloud#4537). Of the two sentences round 1 asked it to carry, the first (divide by the default model's weight; the `default: true` entry carries 1) is now in the spec's describe, so the cloud card can cite the schema instead of restating it. The second (finite positive or absent, never 0 or null) is the schema itself.
- **The PR body is behind the head.** Its "What changes" still quotes the round-1 describe ("default model (1)", "from the model's cost weight"), describes the threshold on the served value and not on the drawn one, and its verification block names heads `0fcd2cfd` and `387c1794`. This record judges the tree. Bringing the body up to the head is the seat's; `PR-body guards` is green.
- All other round-1 flags (i18n in 11 packs, the two unchanged hosts, the docs bullet, narrowed local suites, "asks once" per pick, the line budget) are untouched by the delta and stand.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: S1 closes.** Sentence by sentence against the picker:

- "Factor by which one message on this model draws on the AI allowance, compared with one message on the environment's default model: 20 means one message here uses as much allowance as 20 on the default." The dialog says "Each message on this model uses N times as much of your AI allowance as one on the default model", and the note says "A model marked ×N uses it N times as fast as the default model". Same quantity, same reference model.
- "Normalised to the default: the entry with `default: true` carries 1, and every other entry carries its model's cost weight divided by the default model's cost weight." This is the contract round 1 asked for. The parenthesis is gone, and "from the model's cost weight" can no longer be read as the raw weight: the division is spelled out. With a haiku-scale `cost_weight` and a non-haiku default, a producer that follows this sentence keeps the picker's sentences true.
- "Written by cloud service-ai's GET /api/v1/ai/models; absent when the service reports none, and then nothing is shown for it." The producer is still named (ADR-0049), and absence still means what the picker does.
- **nit:** the sentence does not say whether the `default: true` entry may omit the member while other entries carry it. The picker handles either; the cloud card can settle it.

**`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: S2 and S3 close; one new should-fix and two nits.**

S2. One function, `drawnMultiplierOf`, now feeds the `×N` text, the dialog's number, the note's condition and the threshold test, so what is drawn and whether the person is asked cannot disagree. Tried against it:

- exactly 20: drawn `×20`, asks.
- 19.995: `19.995 * 100` rounds to 2000, drawn `×20`, asks. 19.996 and 19.99500001: the same.
- 19.9949 and 19.994: drawn `×19.99`, apply at once.
- 0.004: drawn `×0.004`. 0.0045: `×0.0045`. 0.5, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001: drawn as written.
- the seam at 1: 0.995 is drawn `×0.99`, 0.996 is drawn `×1`, 1.005 is drawn `×1`. No value near the seam is drawn `×0` or misses a digit.
- below 1 the spelling asks for `1 - floor(log10(n))` fraction digits. For a two-significant-digit value that is exactly the digits it has, and an imprecise `log10` at a power of ten can only ask for one digit more, never one fewer.
- 0, a negative, `NaN`, `Infinity`: `undefined`, nothing drawn, never asks.
- **nit: the far ends.** A finite multiplier above about 1.8e306 overflows `n * 100`, is drawn `×∞`, and asks (the safe side). 1e21 is spelled `×999,999,999,999,999,900,000`. A multiplier below about 5e-21 needs more than the 20 fraction digits the spelling is capped at and is drawn `×0`, so the helper's "never reads ×0" is not literally true. No cost-weight ratio comes near any of these; no effect on the contract.

S3. The pending pick is now an id, and the model is read from the current list on every render.

- Confirm after the list changes (reorder, relabel, a new multiplier): the dialog shows the current entry and Confirm writes an id that is in the list. The outside-item case round 1 described cannot happen.
- Cancel, Escape and an outside dismiss: `onOpenChange(false)` clears the id and writes nothing, as before.
- The pick leaves the list: `confirming` is `undefined`, the dialog closes, and the id is cleared in render (the documented adjust-state-during-render shape, guarded so it cannot loop). If the model comes back, the question does not reopen on its own.
- Two entries with one id: the first is used; the id written is the same either way.
- **should-fix (new, low): a pick that stays in the list but stops being expensive stays asked.** The delta drops the pick only when the model leaves the list. If a relist keeps the model and lowers its multiplier below 20, the question stays open, with a true but no longer required sentence. If the relist takes the multiplier away, the body falls to `?? 0` and reads "uses 0 times as much", which is false. Round 1's snapshot could not reach this; the re-resolve can. Clear `confirmingId` when the current entry's drawn multiplier is below the threshold, the same way as when it leaves. The list is fetched once per pane, so this is as rare as S3 was. Not a must-fix.

Round-1 nits:

- **Closed: the picker trusts `costMultiplier` from a direct host.** `drawnMultiplierOf` now refuses a non-number, a non-finite value and a non-positive one itself, so a host that feeds `models` without `useAiModels` draws nothing for them. The pin file covers `NaN`, `Infinity` and 0.
- **Open, nit:** the `×N` span is still inside `ItemText`.
- **Open, nit:** `/ai/usage` is still read by two hook instances where the dock's ring is mounted.

**`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts`: unchanged, still agrees.** `costMultiplierOf` and `drawnMultiplierOf` refuse the same values, so the hook and the picker cannot disagree about which model has a multiplier.

**`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`: unchanged, still agrees.** It enables `useAiUsage` on "some model carries a multiplier"; the picker's note now keys on "some model has a drawn multiplier". Behind the hook the two are the same set.

No must-fix. S1, S2 and S3 are closed. One new low should-fix in the picker, and nits; none changes the published shape.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-cv4ljj`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `35f32c7f10b97cd250404ebba7789823d18e4efc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx

This is a second delta, on delta record 1 (PASS on `098d07e5477e2aadd128431142cbb3a475866a88`, comment 6892455683), which is itself a delta on the round-1 record (PASS on `387c17942f91721ca9470a679578cc3225b920d8`, comment 6891993315). Everything those two records judged and this one does not name stands as written there.

Read: both earlier records in full, the delta `098d07e5..35f32c7f` (two commits, `4d3ccb7c` and `35f32c7f`; two files: `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and the picker's pin file), card #33660 and its 4 comments, the current PR body, and the check-runs on the head. `protocol.zod.ts`, `useAiModels.ts`, `AiChatPage.tsx` and the changeset are unchanged in the delta. `ModelPicker` was re-read whole at the head. The pin file is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it was read here only to judge whether its new pins hold the guard. Nothing of the tree was built or run: the ablation judgment in ④ is by reading, not by a run.

Check-runs on the head at 2026-11-15T10:21Z: 68 runs, all completed: 59 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed, 0 in progress. Green: Build Core / Docs / UI Deps, every Lint family, every Type Check family, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate. The 9 skipped are opt-in or queue-only jobs.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The published shape does not move in the delta.** No file under `packages/spec` is touched; `costMultiplier` is still `z.number().positive().optional()` with the describe delta 1 judged.
